name: JUnit Test Reports
description: Inspect JUnit XML failures, errors, slow tests and logs offline, preserving source and case identity.
privacy: Offline · Plain-text logs · Reports excluded from history
limits: Up to 32 files; 16 MiB per file, 32 MiB total; depth 64; 50,000 entries. UTF-8 XML only.

empty.title: Find the test that needs attention
empty.hint: Open or drop JUnit XML reports. Browse sources, suites and testcases to inspect failures, stack traces and slow tests.

help: Open or drop one or more UTF-8 JUnit XML reports. Adding a file again retains a separate source; duplicate names are never merged.
Browse source files and suites, filter case names and statuses, and sort by duration. Declared suite metrics are separate from actual descendant cases counted once.
Missing and invalid durations stay unknown. Unsupported extensions and conflicting outcomes produce diagnostics. No flakiness probability is inferred.
Select a detail block to read its body or logs in character pages as plain text. CSV/JSON/Markdown exports follow case filters and exclude full logs.

Limits: 32 files, 16 MiB each, 32 MiB total, depth 64, 200,000 XML elements per file, 50,000 suites/cases/blocks, 4 KiB per attribute, 64 MiB export. Limits fail explicitly. DTD and external entities are rejected. Only the latest parsed report is cached transiently; no database is created.
